metadata.question: Did the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India, decrease between 2018 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 surface reflectance (2018–2019) over Lake Sambhar, India. 2. Masking: Apply QA60 cloud mask (bits 10 & 11) and keep only images with <20 % cloud cover over the lake polygon. 3. Water detection: MNDWI = (Green – SWIR1)/(Green + SWIR1) > 0.2. 4. Logic: Compute yearly water pixel counts for 2018 and 2019. If either year has 0 valid water pixels → C2. If the difference (2019 – 2018) is negative and statistically significant (>5 % relative decrease) → A (Yes); otherwise B (No). Handle missing/empty collections → C1, NaN/None → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Lake Sambhar polygon (approx) geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(75.1, 26.9, 75.3, 27.1) # 2. Sentinel-2 SR helper def get_col(year): return (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x300).eq(0)))) def water_area(img): mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).gt(0.2).rename('water') return (mndwi.select('water') .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) .rename('waterArea')) def yearly_water(year): col = get_col(year) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None img = col.map(water_area).select('waterArea').sum() area = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('waterArea').getInfo() return 0 if area is None else area * 1e-6 # km² # 3. Compute areas a18 = yearly_water(2018) a19 = yearly_water(2019) if a18 is None or a19 is None: print("C1") else: print(f"2018: {a18:.2f} km², 2019: {a19:.2f} km²") if a18 == 0 or a19 == 0: print("C2") else: print("A" if a19 < a18 * 0.95 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Lake Sambhar polygon (approx)
geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(75.1, 26.9, 75.3, 27.1)

# 2. Sentinel-2 SR helper
def get_col(year):
    return (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
              .filterBounds(geom)
              .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')
              .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20))
              .map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x300).eq(0))))

def water_area(img):
    mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).gt(0.2).rename('water')
    return (mndwi.select('water')
            .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
            .rename('waterArea'))

def yearly_water(year):
    col = get_col(year)
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    img = col.map(water_area).select('waterArea').sum()
    area = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                            geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('waterArea').getInfo()
    return 0 if area is None else area * 1e-6  # km²

# 3. Compute areas
a18 = yearly_water(2018)
a19 = yearly_water(2019)

if a18 is None or a19 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2018: {a18:.2f} km², 2019: {a19:.2f} km²")
    if a18 == 0 or a19 == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if a19 < a18 * 0.95 else "<answer>B</answer>")
